definitions.short: something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration) , i.e. a paterre
definitions.full: H6170. arugah [ עֲרוּגָה ] noun feminine garden terrace or bed ; — construct הַבּשֶֹׁם עֲרוּגַת Song 5:13 bed of balsam (simile); plural construct הַבּ ׳עֲרֻגוֺת 6:2 , ׳ע מַטָּעָהּ Ezek 17:7 i.e. where the vine was planted, צִמְחָהּ עֲרֻגֹת 17:10 (all figurative).
